biggest_catch: No tipping system — the per-delivery payout you see before accepting is the whole job; don't expect tip income like food apps.
catches: The user app has no tipping option; cash tips from users are yours to keep but rare.
Dispatch can adjust or cancel a Delivery Fee (e.g., inefficient route, failed job-end in app, user complaint) — reductions are 'exercised in a reasonable manner' but at their discretion.
Daytime-only operation: toggle online 5:00 AM–7:00 PM local; no night work.
23+ with a clean driving record (no DUI in 5 years, no felonies in 10 years); DOT medical exam if over 70.

c1.evidence: Official dispatchit.com: last-mile delivery platform in 80+ markets; drivers self-assign package deliveries, daytime hours.

c2.evidence: Official: 'You see the full payout before you accept, so there's never a guessing game.' Payout calculated per mile + service level + vehicle type.

c3.evidence: Official: 'There are no hidden fees, surprise deductions, or complicated pay formulas.'

c4.evidence: Official: 'With Instant Pay, you can access your earnings within minutes of completing a delivery.' Bounded same-day timing confirmed; weekly Monday direct deposit otherwise.

eligibility: 23+; valid driver's license; clean driving record; background check; reliable vehicle with auto insurance; smartphone; checking account.
maximize: Cherry-pick by the numbers — Dispatch shows the full payout and the pickup-to-dropoff route BEFORE you accept, so only take deliveries whose per-mile rate beats your target and skip dead-end runs (one official selling point is that you see where you're going first). Report wait time, tolls, and heavy lifts through the app's adjustment process — Dispatch's own blog says these get compensated, so never eat those costs silently. And since there's no tipping, treat the shown payout as the whole job: compare it against food-delivery offers running at the same time and take whichever pays more per hour.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Official evidence from dispatchit.com blog + driver terms of use. Verified: full per-delivery payout shown before accept + Instant Pay within minutes. Distinct from Amazon Flex/point-pickup courier apps.

steps: Apply as a Dispatch delivery driver (23+, background check, vehicle, insurance).
Toggle online 5:00 AM–7:00 PM and self-assign deliveries; review full payout and route before accepting.
Pick up and deliver packages; report wait time, tolls, or issues for adjustments.
Access earnings within minutes via Instant Pay, or receive weekly direct deposit on Mondays.
timing: Instant Pay: earnings within minutes of completing a delivery. Otherwise weekly direct deposit every Monday (pay period Friday–Thursday).
payout_value_note: variable per-task pay shown in-app before accepting; no fixed amount in official terms
numeric_basis: remediation 2026-09-23: official terms confirm pay mechanism + timing but no fixed amount; set 0-0 variable (R0004 precedent); time defaulted 15-120min active (flagged for review)
who_pays: Dispatch pays you per delivery — you see the full payout before you accept, so there's no guessing.
who_qualifies: 23+; a valid driver's license and clean driving record (no DUI in 5 years, no felonies in 10 years); a background check; a reliable vehicle with auto insurance; a smartphone; a checking account.
work_available: Daytime-only — you toggle online between 5:00 AM and 7:00 PM local; deliveries are posted in the app when you're online. Availability depends on your market.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the delivery as booked. Dispatch can adjust or cancel a delivery fee at their discretion (for example, an inefficient route, failing to end the job in the app, or a user complaint).
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: waiting between deliveries; your vehicle costs. There is no tipping system — the payout you see before accepting is the whole job.
when_cash_arrives: Instant Pay: earnings land within minutes of completing a delivery. Otherwise, weekly direct deposit every Monday for the Friday–Thursday pay period.
